title: Bug: [Chassis] interfaces-config.service fails on chassis during first boot if there is no config present
author: anamehra
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

On a chassis system (o rmulti-asic), when the system boot first time without any migrated config present, there is no DEVICE_METADATA available. In such case, interfaces-config.service fails due to recently added check for DEVICE_METADTA in the interfaces-config.sh file for smartswitch. This prevents for any dhcp service from starting and the device is not reachable if the system depends on dhcp for initial IP config.
The code should check if DEVICE_METADAT is defined.
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/master/files/image_config/interfaces/interfaces.j2#L134

```

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

The interfaces-config.service should not fail and let the system interface config generate from interfaces.j2 template. If dhcp is supported, it should work.

#### Why I did it
Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/22947

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

#### How I did it
Added check for DEVCIE_METADATA before using it.

#### How to verify it
1. Sonic-installer install a system without any config migration.
2. Just to validate the file:
sonic-cfggen -t /usr/share/sonic/templates/interfaces.j2

Without change:
```
sonic-cfggen -t /usr/share/sonic/templates/interfaces.j2
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/bin/sonic-cfggen", line 517, in <module>
    main()
  File "/usr/local/bin/sonic-cfggen", line 481, in main
    template_data = template.render(data)
